description: Overview of the connected account: nickname, badge balance, membership tier and expiry, published post count, digital human count, join date and profile link. Use it for "how many badges do I have", "when does my membership expire", "how many posts have I published". Difference from whoami: whoami answers "who am I"; this tool answers "what state is my account in".
name: get_my_account
title: My Account Overview
